It’s a grounding ritual that helps you start with intentionality rather than rushing into chaos. Many people—from athletes to CEOs—have similar pre-activity rituals (whether it’s a specific workout, journaling, or even a precise grooming routine) because they know it sets the tone for their entire day. Keep doing what works for you! The fact that it genuinely makes you feel prepared is the most important thing. That’s self-care in action, and it’s a habit worth cherishing. 💡
